notes.title: Offering replacement keys if accidentally revoked
notes.notes:
Recently I was duped by a fake russian bundle site and had to revoke a bunch of keys that I sent them after discovering that they were no-good. These keys WERE unused before sending them to the scammers. Some of them were leftover keys from IndieGala, which I checked after IndieGala returned them to me to make sure that they were unused.

I'm not sure how, but someone has come forth saying I'm the scammer for revoking his keys on his alt accounts. He has over 7000 games, and I doubt he even ever played Little Walker. He seems to be a trading card farmer. I don't understand this generation, I'm old.

ANYWAY, what I really want to say is that I am deeply sorry if I made a mistake and revoked the keys of humble and kind individuals out there. Please contact me with a pic of your indiegala info from the purchase and if you could, a pic that shows you no longer have Little Walker on Steam. blakefix@gmail.com

notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
Remember when I said the last update would be the last update? JK, Now there's a global leaderboard for fastest time from the start of the game to the end.

If you use level select to start at waffle valley you don't need to start a new game to activate a valid run. Level warps and skips are valid, and that's pretty much all there is to it! 

I also added a button on the slide down menu for toggling the dropshadow shader, hopefully improved controller recognition, improved UI look, and fixed more sneaky bugs while I was at it.

Happy holidays everybody!

notes.notes:
The game now recognizes if a controller is plugged in and automagically switches to controller mode. Something I should have done from the start, ha, oopsie daisy.

I also made some superficial changes to the title screen and implemented two lines of code that handle hitting your noggin' against the ceiling if it's a slope to make movement more smooth. wow.

And welp, that's all folks. This is probably the final update. I only did it because I was working on Homegrove and the code I came up with seemed like a good fit for Little Walker as well. Sayonara, have a good one, I'll miss you! Come visit anytime!

notes.title: My bad - How to restore your save!
notes.notes:
Hi again! 

 I realized that while working on the cloudsave feature, I changed where the save files normally go. So you may start the game and be horrified to see your data missing, but it should still exist on your hard drive!

Here's what to do:

- Open steam
- Go to Library
- Right click Little Walker and go to Properties at the bottom.
- Click the Local Files tab, then click "Browse Local Files..."
- Cut or Copy the files that say "save" and "A", and simply paste them into the folder titled "saves"

That should do it! Sorry for the inconvenience. ^_^;

notes.title: New Hard mode, User interface, and improvements!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

It's update time and there's a challenging new hard mode to test your skills. A new achievement to show proof of your accomplishment as well. 

But beyond that I spent a fair bit of time making various improvements!

Probably the most notable would be the fancy new slide-down menu that appears when you hover your mouse near the top of the frame.

Your "spirit bar" is now visible at the top left, and smashing enemies now spawns tokens which fuel your recovery process if you hit 0.

Upon pressing escape it will no longer quit the game, but rather pause the game and give you a list of useful shortcut keys.

Trading Cards should also be up and running in the next couple days as well.

Last but not least I've optimized some things so it should (hopefully) run a little better for some people.

As always, thanks for playing! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Remaining Groupees Bundle Buyers
notes.notes:
To the remaining groupees bundle buyers I'm sorry to say that I won't be sending out any more keys for the steam version of little walker, but please hear me out first on my reasoning.

When I made the agreement with Groupees it was for a version of the game I had put a certain amount of work into (a lot btw). The groupees bundle is long since over and I have already recieved my small percentage of the earnings (like very small, like less than 100 buckaroos). Meanwhile thousands of people got the game for a fraction of a dollar ( which is great! because I had agreed that that version be distributed by them. Also, a portion of that event went to charity, which is even greater ).

SINCE then I have put a lot more work into Little Walker. The steam version didn't happen in a day. Or even a week. Basically this isn't the version I had given Groupees permission to distribute, so I don't feel comfortable updating them with this version.

I'll be finishing sending keys to the people in my gmail inbox, but after that don't fret, Steam is known for having ridiculous sales that may or may not be devaluing games and making it hard for super small indie devs like me to make a reasonable profit from their many months of work >_>

I'm flattered that so many have specifically come forth asking for Little Walker. I thank you for your interest and hope that you find it worthy enough to purchase on the next steam sale or third party bundle.

I think one may be coming up soonish, so I'll be sure to post an announcement for it.
